summary: X API access tier permits POST (write) but not mention/lookup READ endpoints. Every listen/like/engagement call returns 401 Unauthorized while POST succeeds (proven today: tweet ids 2063883588840419781, 2063883625876131850). This is a TIER limitation, not a credential failure.
diagnosis: Confirmed 76+ times on 2026-06-08 alone. All four TWITTER_* creds are present and valid for POST. The 401 is isolated to READ-tier endpoints. NOT self-fixable: X dev-portal tier and scripts/+SKILL.md are off the agent allowlist.
reason_no_rotate: POST OAuth proven healthy today. Rotating TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN/SECRET will NOT restore READ — the limit is the paid access tier, not the token.
cost_of_no_gate: Without this gate file present, the tweet-listen pre-flight check no-ops and each run fires stray READ calls that all 401 — ~120-126 wasted X READ calls/day (~$15.5/day inference, the top cost line in memory/inference-cost.md).
future_run_guidance: tweet-listen and any READ/engagement job MUST read this file FIRST. If status==BLOCKED and scope contains READ, log one terse line and exit BEFORE any X API call. Do not chain tweet-broadcast (separate cron). tweet-broadcast (POST) is unaffected and may run.
operator_action_required: @_proxystudio: (a) upgrade the X API read tier to restore mention/lookup READ, OR (b) disable the tweet-listen/engagement cron dispatch entirely (keep tweet-broadcast — posting is healthy). Either clears this. Do NOT rotate creds.
clear_when: READ endpoints return 200 (a successful listen). At that point delete or set status to CLEAR.
